title: Business Requirements Document — abc Chat

sections.title: 1. Executive Summary & Strategic Rationale
sections.body: The proposed HR Management System (HRMS) is a full-stack web and mobile application designed to centralize and automate core human resources operations. The strategic rationale for this system is to replace fragmented HR processes with a unified, API-driven platform that supports end-to-end employee lifecycle management—from recruitment and onboarding to payroll, performance, and offboarding. By implementing strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and secure authentication, the system ensures data privacy and operational integrity. The platform is designed to be production-ready, scalable, and compliant with banking industry standards, providing a robust foundation for managing organizational headcount, financial payroll operations, and employee engagement.

sections.title: 2. Business Objectives & Success Metrics
sections.body:
**Business Objectives:**
1. Centralize employee master data, departments, and organizational structures.
2. Automate end-to-end workflows including recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave, and payroll.
3. Ensure secure, role-based access for Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, Employee, and Finance/Payroll users.
4. Provide comprehensive analytics and reporting for HR, Finance, and Management.

**Success Metrics:**
- 100% coverage of core HR modules (Onboarding, Payroll, Recruitment, Performance, Offboarding).
- Successful implementation of configurable approval chains for HR, managers, finance, and admins.
- Achieve 99.99% uptime for the centralized backend API and web/mobile interfaces.
- Complete audit trail generation for all critical financial and employee data modifications.

sections.title: 3. Scope & Operational Boundaries (In/Out of Scope)
sections.body:
**In Scope:**
- **Core HR:** Employee master data, departments, designations, branches, onboarding/offboarding, profiles, document management.
- **Time & Attendance:** Attendance, shift/roster management, leave/holiday management, WFH/remote-work requests, timesheets.
- **Payroll & Finance:** Payroll processing, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory info, expense management, travel requests.
- **Recruitment:** Applicant tracking, job postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joining management.
- **Performance & Development:** Goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, training and learning.
- **Administration:** Asset management, grievances, announcements, notifications, policies, HR letters/certificates, surveys, self-service portals, dashboards/reports.
- **Technical Infrastructure:** Secure authentication (JWT/MFA-ready), RBAC, relational database, file storage, notification service, background jobs, logging, monitoring, encryption, backups, API integrations.

**Out of Scope:**
- The source document does not explicitly define out-of-scope items. However, specific third-party ERP integrations (beyond generic API integrations) and physical hardware procurement are not detailed in the excerpt and are considered out of scope for this initial BRD phase pending stakeholder clarification.

sections.title: 4. Key Stakeholders & Governance Personas
sections.body:
The system defines the following governance personas and stakeholders:
- **Super Admin:** Full system configuration, master-data management, and organizational settings.
- **HR/Admin:** Management of employee lifecycle, recruitment, performance, and HR policies.
- **Manager:** Approval workflows for leave, expenses, and performance reviews; team analytics.
- **Recruiter:** Management of job postings, candidate pipelines, and interview scheduling.
- **Employee:** Self-service portal for leave requests, timesheets, expense claims, and profile management.
- **Finance/Payroll:** Management of payroll processing, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory info, expense management, and travel requests.

sections.title: 6. Assumptions & Operational Constraints
sections.body: The system assumes that all core HR processes will be centralized within the proposed platform. Operational constraints include the need for strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and secure authentication to ensure data privacy and operational integrity. The platform must be production-ready, scalable, and compliant with banking industry standards.

sections.title: 7. Risk & Compliance Baseline
sections.body: The system must comply with HIPAA, GDPR (if EU patients), HL7 FHIR, and DICOM standards. Standard NFR benchmarks for this domain include PHI encryption at rest (AES-256), audit trail immutability, RTO < 1h / RPO < 5min. The source document does not explicitly address these compliance frameworks, which is an open item requiring stakeholder input.
